verdict.rationale: Jan's docs say you can give it a task and it works autonomously with files, commands, and web research, and that its agents can read files. This suggests an agent could write or modify documents on disk, but nothing shows a dedicated document drafting or editing workspace. Missing for 10: an integrated document editor or workspace inside Jan, agent-driven inline drafting and editing of documents, automatic saving of changes, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
